CPU_observation_window: All stored resident samples, including noise startup, bulk traffic and migration; main-window peaks retained separately.

variants.old: Archived v20 agent and 250-ms proof hook, original endpoint tail selection.
variants.fast: 100-ms conntrack poll, immediate nft update, TCP_NODELAY and 50-ms proof interval; original endpoint tail selection.
variants.new: Fast control path plus current-keypair counter high-water selection for endpoints and proof events; older authenticated payloads remain eligible for delivery.

noise.fixture: captured authenticated transport prefix, altered ciphertext

CPU.measurement: Whole-VM proc/stat, every nominal 250-ms resident sample plus every rolling four-sample window; full stored interval.

first_new_path_measurement_limit: One frame at IFB transmit after the emulated ingress queue, with source port matched to the new exit-confirmed conntrack mapping. It is a path-arrival timestamp, not an AWG endpoint-write or decryption trace; the old run alone does not prove an endpoint rewind.

UDP_sequence_delivery_control.scope: Diagnostic UDP captures include every test datagram through B tunnel decryption; capture CPU remains measured separately from the primary cohort.

CPU_threshold_failure.explanation: One client-VM sample, before roaming. No per-process profile establishes its source; the cause remains unresolved. The failed measurement is retained and is not converted into a pass by the repeat.

unchanged_from_v20: C classifier and all nftables admission rates/bursts/limits
native client binaries, profiles, keys, application settings and ports
Windows switch binary and QEMU binary
development_notes: Transient build initially had no Go cache/home paths. Explicit GOPATH, GOMODCACHE and GOCACHE fixed the build environment; failed logs remain private.
The analysis now selects the ordinary probe by ICMP identifier, because each client capture can also include the new 50-ms probe.
The optional UDP diagnostic initially reused an existing case name and skipped measurement; a distinct prefix was used before the recorded run. No duplicate was counted.
scope_limits: No production rollout or installer changes.
No physical Windows, macOS, Android or iOS GUI clients operated in this study.
Same-source 64-port noise only; distributed sources and conntrack candidate exhaustion remain untested.
A currently leased spoofed tuple can still pass A until expiry; B rejects invalid ciphertext and this cannot refresh the lease.
No lossless roaming or universal <=90% CPU claim.
Only one selected case verifies every useful UDP datagram by capture; other reported UDP losses are retained as estimates.
No retransmission, historical ciphertext duplication or client-side changes were added.
